Retain merge-support and empty-state semantics as tests when cascade enters the existing attention backend.
Reuse the true-sparse attention seam and require actual sparse work reduction, not dense masking.
The open reusable plan/run contract is the canonical spine; preserve stable addresses and caller ownership.

Use the pinned three-arm native speculative campaign; upstream is a contract/reference only.
Strengthen the existing capture-once/replay-many spine with shared-workspace address stability and no readback.

Borrow shape/arch gate structure while keeping generated kernels and tuning artifacts FAK-owned.

Report native artifact coverage and refuse unsupported shapes rather than fall through to another engine.
Borrow request/shape contracts only; importing a serving runtime would surrender FAK scheduling and kernel ownership.
Feed replayable shape profiles to offline tuning and retain padded-scale correctness as a hard gate.
Add failure-shaped oracles to the existing graph/native test seams before borrowing optimizations.
Build on the shipped compressed-latent MLA seam; preserve LSE convention and sparse-shape hang tests.
Use exact CUDA-kernel work for QSA/GDN and retain architecture/TP/accuracy gates.
Use the shipped bounded device-event trace contract; upstream benchmark labels are not FAK performance claims.
Use the shipped replayable workload-profile tuner and preserve frozen shape/hardware receipts.
Caller-owned workspace and stable addresses remain the single contract.
Track compatibility failures as negative knowledge; FAK artifacts remain versioned and independently witnessed.
Apply specialization to the existing persistent decode hot-set ticket with matched quality and memory accounting.
